title: Atomic rejection fixtures for the packet-16 prefab/property/component/settings command surface
revisionRule: Every step runs at the snapshot revision plus one per preceding step; a request never consumes a revision (durableStateUnchanged is true for the whole case).

cases.title: A prefab instance subtree cannot be captured into a new definition

error.message: the selected subtree contains a prefab instance (components.prefab); M2 definitions cannot contain prefab instances

cases.notes: Nested instances are unrepresentable in M2: capture rejects rather than flattening.

cases.title: The required scene camera cannot be captured

error.message: the selected subtree contains the scene camera; a prefab definition may not contain a camera component

cases.notes: Every v2 scene has exactly one camera (project-model §10.3); capturing it would make the scene invalid on undo/instantiate.

cases.title: An entity-reference property value pointing outside the subtree rejects the capture

error.message: a definition may only contain references that are internal to its own subtree

cases.notes: model-0001 values target=group-0001, which is outside the selected subtree.

cases.title: prefabId is unique and never reused

error.message: a prefab definition with this id already exists

cases.notes: M2 has no prefab deletion, so reusing an id can never be legitimate.

cases.title: Unknown prefabId

error.message: no prefab definition with this id exists in content.prefabs

cases.notes: Instantiation resolves the definition before any ID allocation; nothing is created.

cases.title: Override names a localId the definition does not contain

error.message: the definition contains no entity with this localId

cases.notes: Overrides address (localId, key); both parts must resolve before any entity is created.

cases.title: Override names an undeclared property key

error.message: the behavior declaration for this component does not declare this property key
error.hint: declare the key or drop the override; unknown overrides are never silently dropped

cases.notes: Unknown overrides are a hard failure at every entry point (acceptance: definition changes cannot silently erase user data).

cases.title: Override value does not match the declared type

error.message: the declared property type is number

cases.notes: Types are data, never evaluated: no coercion is attempted.

cases.title: Override entity reference resolves to nothing

error.expected: a localId of prefab-0001 or an existing scene entity ID
error.message: entity reference does not resolve

cases.notes: An entityRef override may name a definition localId (remapped) or an existing scene entity; anything else fails.

cases.title: setBehaviorProperties with an undeclared key

error.message: the behavior declaration does not declare this property key

cases.notes: Attaching a behavior to a second entity with an unknown key changes nothing.

cases.title: setBehaviorProperties with a mistyped value

error.message: the declared property type is boolean

cases.notes: Boolean properties accept only true/false.

cases.title: setBehaviorProperties names an unknown behavior

error.message: no behavior record with this id exists in content.behaviors

cases.notes: The declaration must exist before any value is written.

cases.title: An assetRef property value that no asset record resolves

error.message: asset reference does not resolve in content.assets

cases.notes: Asset references are whole-record references, exactly like components.model.asset.assetId (assets.md §3.2).

cases.title: Removing a declared key that an existing component uses rejects the update

error.message: the new declaration is incompatible with existing behavior components; nothing was written

cases.notes: A declaration update validates every existing use first and never drops stored values.

cases.title: Behavior source publication is unavailable without the packet-33 preparer

error.message: public behavior source publication requires the packet-33 digest-bound compiled preparation record; no unchecked write path exists in M2

pins.section: ### 5.2 Source mode is unavailable in M2

cases.notes: Staging without the preparation record must not become an authoritative write (packet-15 publication pipeline, content-storage.md §6.1).

cases.title: declaration-create with an existing behaviorId

error.message: a behavior record with this id already exists

cases.notes: behaviorId is stable and never reassigned (no deletion in M2).

cases.title: declaration-update for an unknown behaviorId

error.message: no behavior record with this id exists

cases.notes: A create does not upgrade into an update: the mode is explicit.

cases.title: setComponent cannot address transform (or behavior/prefab)

error.message: component is owned by another operation

cases.notes: transform is owned by the accepted setTransform op; behavior by setBehaviorProperties; prefab provenance is read-only. One mutation path per component.

cases.title: setComponent rejects an unknown field inside the component value

error.message: unknown component field

cases.notes: Strict like every other args object: nothing is silently dropped.

cases.title: setSettings accepts only keys declared by the settings registry

error.message: the settings key registry (packet 17) does not declare this key
error.hint: packet 17 pins the M2 settings keys; until then every key is unknown

cases.notes: Packet 16 fixes the container/command shape; the gameplay key registry is packet 17s, and is empty until it is pinned.

cases.title: Subtree deletion is rejected when an outside entity-reference property names a deleted entity

error.message: an entity outside the deleted subtree references an entity inside it
error.hint: clear the referencing property values first, or delete the referencing entity too

cases.notes: This is what keeps the no-dangling-reference invariant true for entityRef property values; the deletion is all-or-nothing.

cases.title: A component write that changes nothing is rejected

error.message: the resulting scene and content are byte-identical to the current state

cases.notes: no_change compares the whole durable state (scene + content), not the scene alone.

cases.title: A stale expectedRevision is reported as stale, not validated

error.message: expected revision does not match the current project revision
error.hint: re-read the project (queryProject) and re-issue the command with a fresh requestId and the current revision

cases.notes: Revision checking precedes argument validation (accepted commands.md §6.1 step 4), for every new op.

cases.title: A recorded requestId reused with different content

error.message: requestId was already used with different content
error.hint: re-read the project, then re-issue the command with a fresh requestId and the current expectedRevision

cases.notes: req-6…06 is the M6 requestId (commands/prefab-scenario.messages.json). Dedup precedes the revision check and is served from the live retry-record map; the envelope fixtures are released-state snapshots and carry no records (packet-15 convention).

constructed.title: Instantiation that would take the scene past 1024 entities
Instantiation under a depth-32 parent (definition depth 2)

notes: Each case starts from a byte-exact durable state (the base envelope or the scenario step named by stateSnapshots) and asserts the final error code plus an unchanged durable state. Intermediate successful steps exist only to build the state a failure needs.

The constructed list holds cases that cannot be expressed as a small fixture (count/byte boundaries); they are normative expected outcomes and are implemented by packets 21/22 without weakening a bound.
Retry/duplicate semantics (F24) additionally rely on the live retry-record map; envelope fixtures carry an empty retry block by the packet-15 released-state convention.
